# Lab News

<div class="content-panel">
  <p>Catch up on recent updates:</p>
</div>

<div id="news-list" class="news-list"></div>

<script type="module">
  import { load } from 'https://cdn.skypack.dev/js-yaml@4.1.0';

  async function renderNews() {
    const res = await fetch('_data/news.yml', { cache: 'no-store' });
    const data = load(await res.text());
    const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.news || []);
    const container = document.getElementById('news-list');

    if (!Array.isArray(list) || !list.length) {
      container.innerHTML = '<p>No news yet.</p>';
      return;
    }

    container.innerHTML = list.map(item => `
      <article class="news-item">
        <div class="news-item__meta">${item.date || ''}</div>
        <h3>${item.title || ''}</h3>
        <p>${item.content || ''}</p>
      </article>
    `).join('');
  }

  renderNews();
</script>
